name: 83712 · Boise, ID
findings: ZIP 83712 (Boise) has 62 nonprofit organizations. 30 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 29 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 83712 (Boise) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 83712 (Boise) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
